jobs.occupation: Landbrugsmedhjælper
jobs.description:
Experienced Milker Wanted for a Modern Jersey Dairy Farm in North Jutland
Would you like to be part of a workplace built on respect, teamwork, and professionalism?

A well-managed dairy farm near Vrå (9760) is looking for an experienced employee for milking and other barn-related tasks. The farm has been operated with great passion and professional expertise for more than 42 years and has built a strong workplace culture where employees support one another, show mutual respect, and share responsibility for the daily work.

The farm is home to approximately 900 Jersey cows and operates with modern facilities and well-established routines that ensure high animal welfare standards and a positive working environment.

About the Position

We are looking for a new team member to strengthen the workforce and help maintain the high standards of daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Milking in a modern 60-point rotary milking parlor
• Bedding cubicles
• Washing and cleaning
• General barn duties
Three employees are involved in the milking operation, and tasks are rotated according to a schedule, providing variety throughout the working week.

Working Hours

Milking takes place:

• 03:00 - 08:00
• 15:00 - 19:30
Weekend work is included according to a rotating schedule.

Typically, you will:

• Work both morning and afternoon milking shifts 1-2 times per week
• Work only one shift per day during the remaining weekdays
There is a shared morning coffee break at 08:00, where colleagues meet and coordinate the day's tasks.

Who Are You?

We expect that you:

• Have experience milking dairy cows
• Speak and understand English
• Have an interest in dairy farming and agriculture
• Thrive in a structured work environment with routines and responsibilities
• Are reliable and flexible
• Are friendly and team-oriented
• Take initiative and approach challenges with a solutions-focused mindset
A driver's license is not required.

We Offer

• Permanent employment with the possibility of many years of service
• Competitive salary based on qualifications
• A stable and professionally managed workplace with 42 years of experience
• An international working environment with both Danish and foreign colleagues
• Supportive colleagues who help one another
• A workplace where respect, cooperation, and professionalism are a natural part of everyday life
The team currently consists of approximately 20 employees, including colleagues from Denmark, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, and Eritrea.

Please contact Tetiana if you want more information. The job is as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Production Assistant – Handmade Porcelain Studio in Glostrup
jobs.description:
Do you like working with your hands and seeing the result of your work every day? MK STUDIO is looking for a new colleague for our workshop.

About us

MK STUDIO makes handmade porcelain cups, plates, bowls and coffee drippers in Glostrup. Our pieces are used in cafés and coffee bars across Denmark, Europe and Asia. We are a small team of seven, with short lines and a good atmosphere in the workshop.

The job

You will be part of the daily production and help bring our porcelain from raw material to finished piece:

• 
Glazing cups, plates and bowls

• 
Loading and unloading our kilns

• 
Mixing glazes and porcelain from our recipes

• 
Finishing cast pieces

• 
Helping with packing when orders pile up

You'll learn how handmade porcelain is produced, step by step, and become a key part of a small team.

We are looking for someone who

• 
Is careful with details and takes pride in good work

• 
Is reliable and likes a steady work routine

• 
Is fine with physical work (lifting up to 20 kg, standing during the day)

• 
Speaks English (Danish is a plus)

• 
Lives in Denmark and has the right to work here

Experience from ceramics or production work is a plus, but not a requirement – we train you.

We offer

• 
150 DKK/hour plus holiday pay

• 
Minimum 32 hours a week guaranteed, Monday–Friday

• 
Full training in the workshop

• 
Pay review after 6 months based on your development

• 
A small, friendly team and a product you can be proud of

Start: October 2026

How to apply

Apply via the form on our website: www.mk-ceramics.com/pages/mk-studio-work-with-us

Tell us a little about yourself and the work you have done before.

At Rays Chicken, we take fried chicken seriously. We make extra-crispy, buttermilk-brined fried chicken seasoned with our proprietary secret spice mix, serving the vibrant, packed crowd at the popular neighborhood spot Gamma Bar in Copenhagen Nordvest.

We are currently laying the groundwork for exciting future growth, and we are looking for a dedicated chef who wants to be an integral part of that journey.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dependable kitchen professional who can take charge of daily kitchen operations, maintain high standards of quality, and keep a cool head during busy periods.

On slower early-week shifts, you will have full autonomy to prep and run the kitchen independently. On busier nights, you will lead the service and direct kitchen support staff.

• 
Independent Shifts: Running kitchen operations solo during early-week shifts.

• 
Team Leadership: Scheduling, guiding, and overseeing kitchen helpers and dishwashers.

• 
Stock & Orders: Managing inventory, placing orders, receiving deliveries, and liaising with daily suppliers.

• 
Hygiene & Safety: Keeping kitchen systems organized and strictly upholding Danish food safety and sanitation standards.

• 
Digital Orders: Operating takeaway and online delivery platforms efficiently.

• 
Menu Input (Bonus): We are actively looking to develop our menu. While not a strict requirement, an interest in recipe testing and creative input is a big plus!

What We Are Looking For:

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional kitchen experience.

• 
Independence: Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills.

• 
Pace & Mindset: Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours.

• 
Stamina: Comfortable working full shifts on your feet.

• 
Availability: Ready and available to work evenings and weekends.

• 
Communication: Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus).

• 
Passion: A true love for fried chicken and high-quality comfort food.

What We Offer:

• 
Hourly wage between 165 and 185 DKK/hour, commensurate with experience.

• 
A relaxed, community-driven atmosphere at Gamma Bar in creative Nordvest.

• 
Opportunity to shape operational routines and influence future menu offerings as the concept expands.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit for Rays Chicken to:

Email: work@diamondslice.dk
